name: Kill Process
description: (Tech) "The End of Machine" enforces "Kill Process" on any technology eclipsing Mundane Earth, forcing ruin upon it: chips torn apart, processors melted, chassis shredded, code mangled, and non-souls sent to oblivion. Potency scales with divergence from Mundane Earth tech and your power difference to the target, but even a normal person could down a spaceship with a glare. Can only affect technology and tech-based targets.
